svg.title: Slant — live link and reaction typing
svg.desc: The video link types first, followed by the visible reaction paragraph. The animation repeats after a reading hold. Original screenshot lettering is preserved. The visible paragraph ends with “with all”, as in the supplied screenshot.
svg.metadata: {"duration_seconds": 52.075, "link_finished": 3.234, "paragraph_start": 4.484, "paragraph_finished": 46.575, "visible_url": "https://youtu.be/LkbYOzOn1VA?si=160bbR-hlyHS1-PW", "visible_paragraph": "We spend close to half of our life's journey being a child, experiencing every emotion, and unknowingly it keeps redefining who we are. Once we have a child, we have a soul that constantly looks to us; our behaviors, our emotions, and everything else become default training data for them. As kids bring immense joy to our lives beyond all their tantrums, they also test our patience, emotional strength, discipline in caring for daily needs, and what not. They act as training data for us, while our responsible handling of how we respond to situations plays a large role in how they will face and conduct themselves in the world tomorrow. Therefore, it is our moral responsibility to raise them with all"}
